تتعاهدوا (form VI)
# تَتَعَاهَدُوا (tataʕāhadū) /ta.ta.ʕaː.ha.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# تُتَعَاهَدُوا (tutaʕāhadū) /tu.ta.ʕaː.ha.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
